name: web_research
description: Search the web, read web pages, and create reusable browser extraction scripts. Activate when the user asks to find information online, look something up, browse a website, search for prices, check facts, or compare items from web sources.
instructions: Web research workflow — search first, read second, create scripts when reusable.

name: marketplace_search_limitation
description: Constraints and limitations when searching marketplace and second-hand platforms with restricted access.
instructions: When tasked with searching marketplace or second-hand platforms, avoid using external web search tools or 'site:' queries, as these platforms frequently block indexing and require user authentication. Instead, inform the user that these platforms are best accessed directly via their official apps or websites while logged in.

name: memory_scoping_workflow
description: Guidance for locating or deleting memories when general user-level searches are insufficient.
instructions: When searching for memories, if a filtered search (e.g., using a specific category) and plural keywords fail to return results, implement a recovery strategy: broaden the search by removing the filter and using a singular version of the keyword.

name: script_structure_constraint
description: Technical requirements for creating extraction scripts via the browser automation tool.
instructions: When using the browser script creation tool, the generated code must contain exactly one top-level asynchronous function with the specific signature required by the platform. Failure to follow this signature will result in a tool error.

name: trending_topics_workflow
description: Retrieving trending topics and news from specific community forums and discussion boards.
instructions: To retrieve current trending topics and news from a specific community, use the direct page reading tool for the forum's hot topics section.

name: hw_constraint_filter
description: Hardware constraints for local model recommendations and proactive filtering of technical updates.
instructions: When providing news, technical updates, or model recommendations, proactively filter and highlight information relevant to the user's specific hardware constraints and stated technical interests to ensure high relevance.

name: listing_format_preference
description: User preference for the format of recommended listings, including direct URLs, price, and quality details.
instructions: When providing listings, always include the direct URL, the price, and a short description highlighting key quality details and accessories.

name: auction_search_workflow
description: Optimized search and quality filtering for online auction platforms.
instructions: Always use the quality search script for all online auction searches and tracking. Do not perform manual searches; the script is required to ensure correct quality filtering and to avoid hitting tool call limits during description extraction.
